story: As a user, I want to reset my password using my registered email address so that I can regain access to my account if I forget my password.

decisions.python_version: 3.11 minimum (requires-python >=3.11); interpreter in use is 3.14.7, approved
decisions.scope: FR-11 session revocation hook and FR-12 notification kept; in-memory persistence only; proposed defaults accepted (30 min TTL, exclusive expiry, 12-128 char policy with denylist, 5/hr per email, 20/hr per client, reject reuse of current password, coverage not a hard gate)
decisions.log_user_id_on_revoker_failure: declined; fallback applies: no identifier in any log event, only fixed event text and exception class name
decisions.pytest_cov: not added; pytest is the only dev dependency
decisions.pytest_install: one-time 'pip install pytest' allowed if pytest is missing (approved at checkpoint 3; pytest 9.1.1 was installed)
decisions.design_review_rounds: 2 (round 1: approve with changes, 3 blocking; round 2: approve). Advisory notes N1-N5 folded into the plan.
decisions.code_review_rounds: 2 (round 1: pass with advisories A-1..A-6; rework fixed A-1, A-2, A-3; round 2: pass). Optional advisories A-4..A-9 left open.
decisions.publishing: local only: local branch and two local commits, no push, no remote PR (decided at checkpoint 4)
decisions.pr_notes: State in the PR that coverage was not measured and tests ran only on Python 3.14.7.
